channel.title: The Null Ledger — monthly results
channel.description: Live paper results of two null-result trading models, published monthly whichever way they point.

item.title: August 2026 result
item.description: Model 1 (S&P ranker): +11.45% vs S&P +2.43% — excess +9.02%. Biggest driver: MRNA +7.3pp (62% of the month). Model 2 (SMALL/clone, forward): -4.49% vs its band +2.61% — excess -7.10%. Record: 2 of 12 rows before judgment. Registered expectation for both models: no edge after costs. Paper only; not advice.

item.title: July 2026 result
item.description: Model 1 (S&P ranker): +3.97% vs S&P +0.03% — excess +3.94%. Biggest driver: MPC +1.1pp (27% of the month). Record: 1 of 12 rows before judgment. Registered expectation for both models: no edge after costs. Paper only; not advice.
